answer: A farm of 201 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in anchor, queued in saffron, and dune publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 16 identities per epoch. A farm of 851 identities would post 647 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
